name: Ceclavín (Spain)
description: White field with a blue embattled stripe along the upper edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ceclavín (crosses of Alcántara, a lion, a column and grapes).
history: Municipal flag of Ceclavín; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Ceclavín arms — crosses of Alcántara, lion, column and grapes
